summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund II LLC filed an 8-K covering three routine items. It disclosed approximately $7.9 million of subscriptions for 319,276 common shares from unaffiliated investors on September 1, 2026, sold on a continuous private-placement basis at NAV per share under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and Regulation S. It declared a regular and special distribution of $0.1785 net per share, payable October 28, 2026 to holders of record September 29, 2026. NAV per share was $24.82 at August 31, 2026; aggregate NAV $87.8 million; debt-to-equity 1.08x. No special-situation transaction is present.
